Only the existing authorized model file may change. Acquire complete current owner via read_source before editing; tests and sibling models are authorized reads. Public behavioral acceptance is frozen and separate final acceptance is withheld. No reference repair provided. Propose an exact grounded edit and use managed checks; repair within the finite bounds if validation identifies an issue.
